options.name: Compel Alacrity
options.benefit: When triggered, the subject can move without provoking attacks of opportunity.

options.name: False Flanker
options.benefit: Create an illusory flanking partner for the subject.

options.name: Fearsome Guise
options.benefit: Make an attacker believe the subject is terrifying.

options.name: Mesmeric Mirror
options.benefit: Create illusory duplicates that can turn attacks aside.

options.name: Psychosomatic Surge
options.benefit: Grant temporary hit points when the subject would be injured.

options.name: Shadow Splinter
options.benefit: Redirect part of an attack into a shadowy double.
